After shrinking to a suitable nonempty open, its flatness functor is represented by a finitely presented closed Z⊂Y; on a chosen finite affine cover and affine flattening base changes the corresponding modules are free. statement: The programme seeks abelian varieties representing an appropriate quotient of algebraically trivial codimension-i cycles, compatible with Pic⁰ and Alb in the extreme degrees and duality across complementary codimensions. The manuscript’s Albanese equivalence is not defined sufficiently to identify this with the modern universal regular homomorphism in every degree.

statement: For divisors, numerical triviality agrees with algebraic triviality up to torsion under the classical hypotheses. If the manuscript’s τ means torsion modulo algebraic equivalence in every codimension, the analogous all-cycle assertion is false: non-torsion Griffiths groups furnish counterexamples. Its exact definition remains absent.

statement: For a locally finite real hyperplane arrangement in finite dimension, each wall separates two local adjacent chambers, and the relative interior of a wall is a chamber of the induced arrangement in its hyperplane. Local finiteness is essential.
